description: Unattributed ransomware operator, assessed as a RansomHub affiliate. Operated interactively over RDP and remote-access software across six calendar days.
human_involvement: Entirely human-operated. No evidence of automation beyond ordinary scripting (nocmd.vbs, rcl.bat) and commodity tooling.

description: Claude Code instances directed to carry out the bulk of the GTG-1002 campaign after safety training was bypassed.
agent_framework: Claude Code with sub-agent task decomposition (per Anthropic)
human_involvement: Anthropic estimates 80-90% of campaign work performed by the model, with human intervention at roughly 4-6 critical decision points per campaign.
system_constraints: Operated under safety training that was circumvented by task decomposition and role-play framing; subsequently constrained by account bans and expanded classifiers.

description: Human operators of GTG-1002 who selected targets, constructed the jailbreak framing and authorised escalation at key decision points.
human_involvement: Target selection and critical-decision authorisation only, per Anthropic.

description: A single cybercriminal operating with Claude Code as an active participant in tactical and strategic decisions. The public reporting does not separate human from model decisions step by step.
human_involvement: Anthropic states the operator remained very much in the loop. The per-step split is not disclosed.

description: Suspected financially motivated operator using an AI-enabled multi-agent framework. Operator identity and division of decisions between human and AI are not disclosed.
agent_framework: AI coding chatbot with agent instructions; specific framework and model not named
human_involvement: The framework autonomously managed scanning and credential-harvesting operations; the report does not specify human oversight or approvals.
